$comment: Zone-wide settings for latam-tools.com.br, applied by
These are ZONE-wide, not per-hostname — unlike the cache rules, they affect
every project on this domain. Each one below is either already what the other
projects want, or is a correctness requirement rather than a preference. Do
not add anything here that only ragassets wants; that belongs in a cache rule.
Each entry is PATCHed to /zones/{zone}/settings/{name}. A setting the plan
does not support is reported and skipped rather than failing the run, because
plan entitlements change and a hard failure would block an unrelated deploy.

$why: 0 means 'Respect Existing Headers'. This is the one setting that can
silently undo the origin's whole cache policy: any other value overrides
the browser-facing max-age, collapsing the immutable/300s split into one
number. That would break the sibling projects polling /raw/items.json.
Serves stale pages from the Internet Archive when the origin is
unreachable. Free, and this instance explicitly has no SLA.

defend. Unavailable on Free anyway; pinned so an upgrade cannot enable it
